stem:
Krish copies the feeding diagram shown below from a Class 8 field booklet.

Is the diagram a food chain or a food web, and why?

options.text: A food web, because more than one feeding path links the organisms.
A food chain, because any diagram with arrows between living things is called a food chain.
A food chain, because rice is drawn at the bottom so there can be only one sequence.
Neither, because the labels are organism names rather than the word producer or consumer.

teacher.key_rationale: Interlinked paths (rice to grasshopper to frog to snake to hawk, and rice to mouse linked to hawk and snake) form a food web, not a single linear food chain. Arrow presence alone, bottom placement of rice, or missing producer/consumer words do not decide the label.
teacher.figure_note: Feeding diagram with interlinked paths among rice plant, grasshopper, frog, snake, mouse, and hawk.
